construct: WASp links hematopoietic-cell signaling to actin-cytoskeleton remodeling. Loss of WASp disrupts immune-cell migration, phagocytosis, and immunologic-synapse formation and is associated with characteristically small platelets and thrombocytopenia.

adversarial_second_pass.independent_reconstruction: Male infant with recurrent infections, eczema, thrombocytopenia, characteristically small platelets, and X-linked family history identifies Wiskott-Aldrich syndrome.
adversarial_second_pass.strongest_distractor_attack: Chediak-Higashi also causes recurrent infections and a trafficking defect, but it produces giant leukocyte granules and partial albinism; CGD lacks thrombocytopenia/small platelets; LAD lacks eczema and causes leukocytosis with poor pus formation.
adversarial_second_pass.expert_reviewer_reversal: The small-platelet thrombocytopenia plus eczema is highly discriminating, and WASp-dependent actin remodeling uniquely links the hematologic and immune phenotype.
